## Activity

During October 2022, East City Eye Clinic recorded 177 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and indicates the volume of images submitted for review. The recorded activity should be considered alongside the image quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

There were 5 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 2.8 per cent. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate operational process. Maintaining a record of these issues will support review of image quality and help identify any continuing effect on the service.

## Grading

Grading identified 41 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. These results should be reviewed through the usual clinical and operational arrangements. The grading measure should be considered with the ungradable rate, as both indicators provide information about the quality and timeliness of the service delivered during October 2022.
